# Andrea Saravia Sauter — SARAUTER

> Senior B2B marketing leader in telecom and digital infrastructure. 20+ years across LATAM and Europe building brands, pipeline and flagship events — now with AI systems on top. Based in Madrid, Spain.

Andrea Saravia Sauter is a Marketing Director with 8 years leading brand development for Ufinet (2014–2022), a digital infrastructure company operating in 17 countries — backed by a written reference from Ufinet's CEO. Since 2022 she has worked as a marketing consultant and project lead for Todofibraoptica, Gold Data, and Avenza Marketing, and currently advises Ufinet on brand positioning. She holds a Master in Digital Marketing (ESIC Business & Marketing School, Madrid) and integrates AI systems (Claude/Anthropic) into marketing execution as repeatable workflows.
